items.title: Google Project Zero Discloses Zero-Click Exploit Chain for Pixel 10 Devices
items.description: A newly disclosed zero-click exploit chain targeting Google Pixel 10 devices has raised fresh concerns about Android’s low-level security. Google Project Zero researchers demonstrated how attackers could silently compromise a device and escalate privileges to root without any user interaction by chaining just two vulnerabilities. The attack builds on earlier research targeting Pixel 9 devices,…

items.title: Android 16 VPN Bypass Lets Malicious Apps Reveal Users Real IP Address
items.description: A newly disclosed flaw in Android 16 is raising serious privacy concerns after researchers revealed that malicious apps can bypass VPN protections and expose a user’s real IP address even when strict security settings are enabled.
